goal: OAuth review: redirect URI checks, PKCE, state parameters and token storage.
use: OAuth review: redirect URI checks, PKCE, state parameters and token storage. Use when code implements an OAuth or OpenID Connect sign-in.

steps.note: Check the flow. Use the authorisation code flow with PKCE for public clients.
Check redirects. Redirect URIs must match exactly, with no open redirects.
Check state. The state parameter must be random and checked on return.
Check tokens. Flag tokens stored in local storage or logged.
Report. Each finding with file and line, severity and the fix.
